# FDGA001

> DO place the opening brace on the next line, indented to the same level as the block statement.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section A.1.1 Brace Usage.

This is a coding style convention. The book treats the appendix A conventions as suggestions, so you can override it.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: IDE0055
- Automatic fix: yes
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

IDE0055 keeps blocks that open and close on one line (csharp_preserve_single_line_blocks = true, for FDGA008); FDGA003 reports those of statements and member bodies.

## Options

```ini
csharp_new_line_before_open_brace = all
```

## From the book

```csharp
if (someExpression)
{
    DoSomething();
}
```
